win.title: CROSSED!
win.body: Two allergens at once. Each grain alone only armed the mast cell — it is the CROSSED pair that flips the trigger, calcium pours in, and the granules empty in a burst.
win.biologyLine: Mast cells need two IgE-bound allergens linked together to degranulate. One key won't do — that's why the signal has a bivalency requirement.

fail.title: ANAPHYLAXIS
fail.body: Too much. Both allergens pushed the cell far past its trigger — histamine flooded the tissue, blood vessels dilated, airways swelled, blood pressure crashed.
fail.biologyLine: Severe allergic reaction — life-threatening within minutes. This is why people with serious allergies carry adrenaline auto-injectors.

hints.drag: Drag from EACH pollen grain, toward the cell
hints.tap: Tap BOTH pollen grains — one is not enough
hints.hold: Swirl around a grain to release more
hints.pinch: Spread two fingers (or press +) to release more
